g.title: end_to_end_data_flow
g.text: AERIS-10 - end-to-end signal and control data flow (antenna -> RF -> ADC -> FPGA -> host; host -> STM32 -> clock/LO/beamformer -> FPGA)
Drawing ID: SD-07 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: PARTIAL - the FPGA-to-host data path has NO hardware (FT601 unwired) and several interfaces are unverified

Source: docs/SYSTEM/BLOCK_DIAGRAM.md (EAGLE connector nets + firmware + RTL), docs/FPGA/FPGA_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md 6-7, docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md 3.2-3.3 and STM-T04, docs/GUI/DEPENDENCIES.md 4 and 6,
Edge styles: SOLID = confirmed by schematic net AND firmware/RTL reference; DASHED = interface exists in one source only or mapping unverified; DOTTED RED = missing specification / no hardware path

g.title: ant
g.text: NO CAD, NO PART, two different simulations (BLOCK_DIAGRAM 1, K8)

g.title: sw
g.text: 16+1 SMA pairs J22..J55 to PA boards

g.title: pa
g.text: J1 RFIN / J2 RFOUT; X3 VD,VIN_M; X2 VG

g.title: adc
g.text: LVDS D0..7 + DCO to FPGA bank 14

g.title: dac
g.text: DAC_0..7 from FPGA bank 15; clock 120 MHz AD9523 OUT10 via J20

g.title: adc->fpga
g.text: LVDS D0..7 + DCO, bank 14 at 3.3 V

g.title: fpga->adar
g.text: 1.8 V SPI + TR + LOAD lines, bank 34
SPI never driven in RTL; TR/LOAD from

g.title: host
g.text: GUI_V5.py: STM32 CDC (pyusb) + FTDI FT2232H (pyftdi) - no FT2232H exists on the board
radar packet format A5C3+CRC16 (GUI) vs 0xAA..0x55 (RTL) - conflict K5

g.title: fpga->host
g.text: NO HARDWARE PATH EXISTS - GUI expects

g.title: stm
g.text: main.cpp: power sequencing, AD9523/ADF4382 config (SPI4), ADAR1000 (SPI1), PA bias (I2C1/I2C2),
sensors (I2C3/UART5), stepper (PD4/PD5), FPGA handshake (PD8..PD12), USB CDC to host

g.title: ad9523
g.text: SPI4 + control via JP1<->JP1; CS PF7
OUT4 400 MHz ADC, OUT5 400 MHz FPGA

g.title: lotx
g.text: ADF4382 U1 - TX LO (10.5 GHz per adf4382a_manager.c:54)

g.title: pwr
g.text: PA 22 V requirement (xlsx) has no rail

g.title: sens
g.text: Off-board modules (no part numbers): GPS (JP8, UART5 9600), GY-85 IMU + BMP180 (JP7/JP18, I2C3),
stepper driver (JP9, PD4/PD5), fan relay (JP4, PD7), PA drain switch (JP10, PD6)

g.title: ft601->host
g.text: USB 3.0: no connector, no cable, no

g.title: usbx
g.text: the ONLY host data link in the CAD (BLOCK_DIAGRAM 2.4)

g.title: osc
g.text: OCXO 100 MHz X4 / VCXO 50 MHz X5,X6 (schematic)
vs xlsx VCXO 100 MHz / firmware vcxo_freq 100 MHz - conflict K7

g.title: pwr->pa
g.text: V PA drain (xlsx) has no rail

g.title: pwr->stm
g.text: several rail names differ or are not

g.title: legend
g.text: SOLID black edge = interface confirmed by a schematic net AND a firmware/RTL reference (file:line in label)
DASHED edge = unverified: present in only one source, anonymous net, inferred mapping, or wiring confirmed but driver/RTL broken (orange = documented defect)
DOTTED RED edge = missing specification or no hardware path at all

red dotted box = component with no wiring/CAD; orange box = documented conflict (K-numbers from docs/SYSTEM/BLOCK_DIAGRAM.md section 4; C-numbers from docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md STM-T04)
KEY FINDING: the only wired host link is STM32 USB-FS CDC (control + GPS/status). The FPGA radar-data output (usb_data_interface.v) targets an FT601 that has no nets;
no GUI version can decode the RTL packet format (K5). Therefore no end-to-end radar data path exists in the repository as committed.
NOT VERIFIED: any electrical measurement, RF levels, LO/IF frequency plan beyond the constants quoted, cable harness, antenna
